worklist.outreach_script_en: Hi, this is a check-in about your blood pressure medication. We noticed a recent change to your prescription and want to make sure everything is going smoothly. Do you have any questions about your new dose?
worklist.outreach_script_es: Hola, le llamamos para preguntar sobre su medicamento para la presion. Notamos un cambio reciente en su receta y queremos asegurarnos de que todo vaya bien. ¿Tiene alguna pregunta sobre la nueva dosis?

worklist.outreach_script_en: Hi, we'd like to help make sure you can get to the pharmacy to pick up your prescription. We may be able to arrange transportation support. Can we talk about your options?
worklist.outreach_script_es: Hola, queremos ayudarle a llegar a la farmacia para recoger su receta. Es posible que podamos ofrecer apoyo de transporte. ¿Podemos hablar sobre sus opciones?

worklist.outreach_script_en: Hi, it's been a little while since your last visit. We wanted to check in and see how you're doing with your medication, and if there's anything we can help with.
worklist.outreach_script_es: Hola, ha pasado un tiempo desde su ultima visita. Queriamos saber como esta con su medicamento y si hay algo en lo que podamos ayudar.

worklist.outreach_script_en: Hi, we want to make sure you have everything you need to keep up with your blood pressure medication, including a safe place to store it. Can we connect you with some additional support?
worklist.outreach_script_es: Hola, queremos asegurarnos de que tenga todo lo necesario para continuar con su medicamento, incluido un lugar seguro para guardarlo. ¿Podemos conectarle con apoyo adicional?
